instrumentNote.title: What this is — and what it is not
instrumentNote.selfReport: Everything here comes from you. None of it has been measured, tested or checked from the outside.
instrumentNote.notATest: It is not a validated test. There is no comparison to a norm, no score and no statement about whether somebody is suited to founding — such statements could not be supported by this data.
instrumentNote.snapshot: It is a snapshot. People answer differently in a different situation, and that is not a fault of the answer.
instrumentNote.purpose: What it is for: as a basis for a conversation — between people who want to found together, or with somebody accompanying them. Not as a basis for selection.
